name: ai.exducer/turbo
title: ExducerAI GPU cloud
description: Rent whole RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs in Montréal: quote, book, connect, stop, billing.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List prices in CAD: GPU-hour per GPU model, object storage per GB-month, and the Models API. Use this instead of any remembered price.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: One yes or no per GPU model: is it free right now. A no does not block a request; the request waits for capacity.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: The public status of each service (console, API, GPU region, object storage, Models API).

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: The servers a booking can name: id (the server_id of quote_booking and create_booking), GPU model, price per GPU-hour in CAD, allowed_gpu_counts, region, and whether it is free now.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The templates a booking can name: slug, name, the container image it runs, category. Without a template a deployment runs the default PyTorch image.

tools.name: quote_booking
tools.description: What a booking would cost in CAD: GPU cost, tax and total for the whole duration, and the hourly rates. Books nothing and charges nothing. Always quote and show the user the total before create_booking.

gpus.description: Number of GPUs: one of the server's allowed_gpu_counts.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the documentation by keyword. Returns the matching sections with a snippet and the slug to pass to read_doc.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: One documentation page as Markdown, by its slug (from search_docs). Read the page before answering a question about how the platform works.

slug.description: The page slug, e.g. c-provisioning (from search_docs).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account behind the API key (email, company, type), whether the key is a sandbox key, and the prepaid balance in CAD (simulated under a sandbox key).

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: Every deployment of the account with its state, GPU count, rate, cost so far and end time. States: requested, queued, provisioning, running, then stopped, ended, failed or cancelled.

include_sandbox.description: On a live key, also list sandbox deployments.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: One deployment in full: state and reason, SSH host and port, the host key fingerprint to verify, rate per GPU-hour, cost so far, start and end time, endpoints.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

tools.name: get_deployment_events
tools.description: The state changes of a deployment, oldest first, each with its reason, actor and time. Read this to learn why a deployment failed, ended or is waiting.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

tools.name: wait_for_deployment
tools.description: Poll a deployment until it reaches a state (default running) or a final state, for at most 50 seconds per call. Returns reached, the current state and whether it is final. While reached is false and final is false, call again; a live request can stay requested until staff place it, so after a few minutes tell the user and check back later instead of looping.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait in this call.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: The prepaid balance and the most recent credit ledger lines (top-ups and charges) in CAD.

limit.description: How many ledger lines, newest first.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: What the account was charged for GPU time, object storage and the Models API over a date range, in CAD before tax. Only deployments that ran appear.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, America/Toronto. Default: the first of the month.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Default: today.

group.description: day: one row per day and type. type: one row per type for the range.

deployment_id.description: Only the GPU time of this deployment.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: The account's invoices (not available to a sandbox key).

tools.name: list_ssh_keys
tools.description: The SSH public keys saved on the account: a booking with no ssh_public_key uses them (not available to a sandbox key). Adding or removing keys is done by the user in the console.

tools.name: get_storage_usage
tools.description: Object storage: GB stored, active keys, price per GB-month and the amount billed this month (not available to a sandbox key).

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Send a GPU request. It is created as requested or queued and becomes running later (use wait_for_deployment); nothing is charged before it runs, then credit is drawn per minute. Quote first with quote_booking and get the user's yes on the total. Retry-safe: see idempotency_key.

gpus.description: Number of GPUs: one of the server's allowed_gpu_counts.

hours.description: Duration in hours. A live booking has a minimum (the API answers duration_below_minimum under it).

ssh_public_key.description: The text of the user's SSH public key (.pub), one key per line. Left out, the keys saved on the account are used. Required with a sandbox key.

template.description: Template slug from list_templates. Left out: the default PyTorch image.

image.description: A container image instead of a template. Only images the platform already runs are accepted.

notes.description: A note for the staff who place the request.

client_reference.description: Your own reference for this deployment; unique among the account's live deployments.

auto_renew.description: Renew by itself at the end of the term while credit lasts.

sandbox_scenario.description: Sandbox keys only: the lifecycle to simulate.

sandbox_speed.description: Sandbox keys only: shorten every simulated wait this many times.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. 8 to 128 characters. Reuse the same value when retrying the same request. Left out, one is derived from the request and the UTC date, so the identical request the same day returns the first answer; pass a new value to really do it a second time.

confirm.description: Must be true. It states that the user approved this exact action after seeing what it does and costs. With a sandbox key (tml_test_…) nothing is real and it may be set freely.

tools.name: extend_deployment
tools.description: Add hours to the term of a deployment that is requested, queued, provisioning or running. Same machine, same SSH details; billing stays per minute. Tell the user the extra cost (hours × gpu_count × rate) and get a yes first. Retry-safe: see idempotency_key.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

hours.description: Hours to add. The new end may not be more than 720 hours away.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. 8 to 128 characters. Reuse the same value when retrying the same request. Left out, one is derived from the request and the UTC date, so the identical request the same day returns the first answer; pass a new value to really do it a second time.

confirm.description: Must be true. It states that the user approved this exact action after seeing what it does and costs. With a sandbox key (tml_test_…) nothing is real and it may be set freely.

tools.name: set_auto_renew
tools.description: Turn automatic renewal of a deployment on or off. On, it keeps running and drawing credit past its end time until it is turned off or credit runs short, so get the user's yes first.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

enabled.description: true: renew at the end of each term while credit lasts. false: end as booked.

confirm.description: Must be true. It states that the user approved this exact action after seeing what it does and costs. With a sandbox key (tml_test_…) nothing is real and it may be set freely.

tools.name: stop_deployment
tools.description: Stop a deployment now: billing ends at this minute and its container and NVMe scratch disk are deleted and cannot be recovered. A request that has not started is withdrawn at no cost. Make sure results are copied off, tell the user the disk is deleted, and get a yes first.

id.description: The deployment id (rnt_… on a live key, snd_… in the sandbox).

confirm.description: Must be true. It states that the user approved this exact action after seeing what it does and costs. With a sandbox key (tml_test_…) nothing is real and it may be set freely.
